NIGAHI PROJECT
Time - . 5 Owner - Northern Coalfields Ltd.
Dist. - Singrauli, State - Madhya Pradesh
Person(s) Killed :
1. S.S. Shah, Cont. Employee, Male, 26 Years
While an 18.8 m3 empty tipper was on way to loading face it crashed into right side
dump body of OB loaded tipper coming from the opposite direction at haul road
junction thus punctured the fuel tank of loaded tipper resulting in diesel spill
out to catch fire in both the tippers and empty tipper driver unable to escape as
was being entrapped in damaged cabin was burned to death.
Had,
the empty tipper not been driven unmindfully without paying attention to signals
like horn & dipper given by driver of loaded tipper coming from opposite direction
to crash into it, thus not negligently endangering his own life and safety of
persons employed in the mine, as called for by the provisions of Regulation 239 of
the Coal Mines Regulations, 2017,
this accident could have been averted.
